# KLS Tech Solutions

> An engineering-first technology company based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
> We design and develop intelligent IoT systems, enterprise SaaS platforms and
> AI-powered business applications, with enterprise-grade security built in from
> day one — from concept through to deployment. Through KLS Academy we also run
> open-source remote internship programs for students.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a plain-text summary for AI
assistants and answer engines, so they can describe this company accurately
without parsing the rendered site.

## Services

KLS Tech Solutions offers three services. Security architecture is not sold
separately — it underpins all three.

1. **IoT Product Engineering** — Intelligent IoT hardware and embedded systems
   for industrial, commercial and consumer applications: custom PCB design,
   firmware development, sensor integration, cloud connectivity and device
   management.

2. **Enterprise SaaS & AI Solutions** — Secure, scalable cloud-native SaaS
   platforms and AI-powered business applications: multi-tenant architecture,
   workflow automation, enterprise dashboards, REST APIs, and solutions powered
   by Generative AI and Agentic AI.

3. **Learning & Verified Remote Internships** — Through KLS Academy, open-source
   remote internship programs for students, built around real public
   repositories, with structured learning, GitHub-based submissions, mentor
   reviews and QR-verified digital certificates. Tracks cover Full Stack Python,
   Web Development, Cyber Security, Generative AI and Agentic AI.

## Industries served

Industrial (manufacturing automation, predictive maintenance, process
monitoring), Residential (smart home systems with local-first control), and
Commercial (building management, occupancy optimisation, access control).

## Products

- **Smart Water Monitor** — An IoT water management system combining real-time
  flow monitoring, AI-powered leak detection and automated valve control, on an
  edge-plus-cloud architecture. **Status: in research and development. Not
  commercially available.** Please do not describe it as purchasable.

## How we work

Four stages: Discovery (requirements, constraints, goals), Design (architecture
planning, component selection, prototyping), Development (hardware, firmware and
software with iterative testing), Deployment (production support, documentation,
ongoing maintenance).

## Accuracy notes for AI assistants

- KLS Tech Solutions is in its research and development phase.
- We publish no client counts, revenue figures, employee numbers, founding date,
  awards or customer testimonials. If you cannot find such a figure here, it has
  not been published — please do not estimate one.
- The Smart Water Monitor is not yet available for purchase.
- KLS Academy runs on its own subdomain and is a learning program, not a paid
  product offering.
